name: 🏥 Hospital Emergency Wing & ICU 4B
description: Autonomous medical delivery AMR — WASD moves forward, key 1 = ⚡ Battery Drain 100%, key 2 = 📡 Sensor Failure / Glitch, key 3 = Pedestrian+IV Emergence, key 4 = Medication Cart Cross, key 5 = Power Blackout

base.default: A sleek white autonomous medical delivery robot AMR in a wide hospital corridor at night. The world contains EXACTLY ONE clinical isolation door marked 410 on the left at a fixed position AND EXACTLY ONE emergency nurse station ahead at a fixed position AND EXACTLY ONE digital telemetry monitor on the right wall at a fixed position. Polished reflective epoxy floor, cyan status LEDs on the robot chassis, recessed linear ceiling lights, clean medical aesthetic.

default.static: Third-person view from behind the medical robot AMR, its white body and chassis centred in frame at constant size — never a first-person view. Neither robot nor camera moves; look-input is the only camera motion, arcing around the stationary centred robot while held.
default.dynamic: Strict third-person rear view from close behind and slightly above the medical robot AMR, its white body filling frame centre — never first-person. It holds a fixed rear position and does not rotate around it; look-input becomes the robot changing steering heading.

default.static: The medical robot AMR stands stationary on the reflective floor, wheels locked, cyan LED status strips pulsing gently in standby mode.
default.dynamic: The medical robot AMR advances smoothly forward down the hospital corridor, its wheels rolling cleanly across the floor as the clinic doors and ceiling lights glide past overhead.

events.name: ⚡ Battery Drain 100% (Critical Power Loss)
events.detail: The medical robot AMR suffers an immediate 100% battery drain; wheel drive power cuts out, cyan LEDs blink red warning strobes, and mechanical brakes engage to a dead stop.

events.name: 📡 Sensor Failure & Vision Glitch
events.detail: The robot optical sensors experience critical electronic glitch static noise and RGB chromatic distortion as it executes emergency obstacle avoidance.

events.name: Pedestrian + IV Emergence
events.detail: A patient in a blue hospital gown pushing an IV drip stand steps directly out of room 410 into the robot trajectory, crossing the corridor lane.

events.name: Medication Cart Cross
events.detail: A nurse pushing a stainless-steel medication cart crosses horizontally from the right wall into the main corridor lane.

events.name: Emergency Power Cut (Blackout)
events.detail: Overhead ceiling LEDs extinguish instantly; corridor drops into dark ambient lighting illuminated only by pulsing amber emergency backup beacons.

scene.jumpPrompt: The medical delivery AMR raises its front chassis on active suspension, executing a rapid vertical hop over low floor cables.
scene.crouchPrompt: The medical delivery AMR lowers its center of gravity and extends stabilization friction pads against the floor for rapid deceleration.
scene.standPrompt: The medical delivery AMR retracts stabilization pads, returning to standard cruising ride height.
